calls.cypher: MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(n:Function) WHERE contains(lower(n.name), lower("e")) RETURN n.name AS name, 'Function' AS kind, file.relativePath AS file, n.line AS line, n.isExported AS isExported, 'DEFINES_FUNCTION' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, n.line, n.name LIMIT 21

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_CLASS]->(n:Class) WHERE contains(lower(n.name), lower("e")) RETURN n.name AS name, 'Class' AS kind, file.relativePath AS file, n.line AS line, n.isExported AS isExported, 'DEFINES_CLASS' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, n.line, n.name LIMIT 21

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_VARIABLE]->(n:Variable) WHERE contains(lower(n.name), lower("e")) RETURN n.name AS name, 'Variable' AS kind, file.relativePath AS file, n.line AS line, n.isExported AS isExported, 'DEFINES_VARIABLE' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, n.line, n.name LIMIT 21

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_INTERFACE]->(n:Interface) WHERE contains(lower(n.name), lower("e")) RETURN n.name AS name, 'Interface' AS kind, file.relativePath AS file, n.line AS line, n.isExported AS isExported, 'DEFINES_INTERFACE' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, n.line, n.name LIMIT 21

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_TYPE_ALIAS]->(n:TypeAlias) WHERE contains(lower(n.name), lower("e")) RETURN n.name AS name, 'TypeAlias' AS kind, file.relativePath AS file, n.line AS line, n.isExported AS isExported, 'DEFINES_TYPE_ALIAS' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, n.line, n.name LIMIT 21

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_ENUM]->(n:Enum) WHERE contains(lower(n.name), lower("e")) RETURN n.name AS name, 'Enum' AS kind, file.relativePath AS file, n.line AS line, n.isExported AS isExported, 'DEFINES_ENUM' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, n.line, n.name LIMIT 21

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_CLASS]->(cls:Class)-[:DEFINES_METHOD]->(n:Function) WHERE contains(lower(n.name), lower("e")) RETURN n.name AS name, 'Method' AS kind, file.relativePath AS file, n.line AS line, cls.isExported AS isExported, 'DEFINES_METHOD' AS relationship, cls.name AS className ORDER BY file.relativePath, n.line, n.name LIMIT 21

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(n:Function) WHERE n.isExported = true RETURN file.relativePath AS file, n.name AS name, 'Function' AS kind, n.line AS line, 'DEFINES_FUNCTION' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, n.line, n.name LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_CLASS]->(n:Class) WHERE n.isExported = true RETURN file.relativePath AS file, n.name AS name, 'Class' AS kind, n.line AS line, 'DEFINES_CLASS' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, n.line, n.name LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_VARIABLE]->(n:Variable) WHERE n.isExported = true RETURN file.relativePath AS file, n.name AS name, 'Variable' AS kind, n.line AS line, 'DEFINES_VARIABLE' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, n.line, n.name LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_INTERFACE]->(n:Interface) WHERE n.isExported = true RETURN file.relativePath AS file, n.name AS name, 'Interface' AS kind, n.line AS line, 'DEFINES_INTERFACE' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, n.line, n.name LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_TYPE_ALIAS]->(n:TypeAlias) WHERE n.isExported = true RETURN file.relativePath AS file, n.name AS name, 'TypeAlias' AS kind, n.line AS line, 'DEFINES_TYPE_ALIAS' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, n.line, n.name LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_ENUM]->(n:Enum) WHERE n.isExported = true RETURN file.relativePath AS file, n.name AS name, 'Enum' AS kind, n.line AS line, 'DEFINES_ENUM' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, n.line, n.name LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[:RE_EXPORTS]->(target:Import) WHERE true RETURN file.relativePath AS file, target.source AS name, 'Import' AS kind, target.line AS line, 'RE_EXPORTS' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, target.line, target.source LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[:RE_EXPORTS_FUNCTION]->(target:Function) WHERE true RETURN file.relativePath AS file, target.name AS name, 'Function' AS kind, target.line AS line, 'RE_EXPORTS_FUNCTION' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, target.line, target.name LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[:RE_EXPORTS_CLASS]->(target:Class) WHERE true RETURN file.relativePath AS file, target.name AS name, 'Class' AS kind, target.line AS line, 'RE_EXPORTS_CLASS' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, target.line, target.name LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[:RE_EXPORTS_VARIABLE]->(target:Variable) WHERE true RETURN file.relativePath AS file, target.name AS name, 'Variable' AS kind, target.line AS line, 'RE_EXPORTS_VARIABLE' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, target.line, target.name LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[:DECLARES_ROUTE]->(route:Route) WHERE true OPTIONAL MATCH (route)-[:ROUTE_HANDLED_BY]->(handler:Function) RETURN file.relativePath AS file, route.line AS line, route.method AS method, route.path AS path, route.fullPath AS fullPath, route.framework AS framework, route.handlerName AS handlerName, handler.name AS handler ORDER BY file.relativePath, route.line, route.method, route.path, handler.name LIMIT 51
MATCH (file:File) WHERE file.dynamicRouteCalls IS NOT NULL RETURN file.relativePath AS file, file.dynamicRouteCalls AS calls ORDER BY file.relativePath

MATCH (file:File)-[:DECLARES_ENTRYPOINT]->(entrypoint:EntryPoint) WHERE true OPTIONAL MATCH (entrypoint)-[:ENTRYPOINT_HANDLED_BY]->(handler:Function) RETURN file.relativePath AS file, entrypoint.line AS line, entrypoint.kind AS kind, entrypoint.trigger AS trigger, entrypoint.library AS library, entrypoint.handlerName AS handlerName, handler.name AS handler ORDER BY file.relativePath, entrypoint.line, entrypoint.kind, entrypoint.trigger, handler.name LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[rel:USES_ENV_FILE]->(env:EnvVar) WHERE true RETURN 'env' AS kind, file.relativePath AS file, rel.line AS line, env.name AS name, rel.access AS value, NULL AS valueType, file.relativePath AS consumer, 'File' AS consumerKind ORDER BY file.relativePath, rel.line LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[:DECLARES_CONFIG_FILE]->(config:ConfigValue) WHERE true RETURN 'config' AS kind, file.relativePath AS file, config.line AS line, config.name AS name, config.value AS value, config.valueType AS valueType, file.relativePath AS consumer, 'File' AS consumerKind ORDER BY file.relativePath, config.line LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[rel:CONSUMES_CONFIG_FILE]->(config:ConfigValue) WHERE true RETURN 'config-consumer' AS kind, file.relativePath AS file, config.line AS line, config.name AS name, config.value AS value, config.valueType AS valueType, rel.localName AS consumer, 'File' AS consumerKind ORDER BY file.relativePath, config.line LIMIT 51

MATCH (source:File)-[rel:ACCESSES_DATA_FILE]->(model:DataModel) WHERE true WITH source AS file, source, rel, model OPTIONAL MATCH (model)-[:MAPS_TO_TABLE]->(table:Table) RETURN 'File' AS sourceKind, source.relativePath AS sourceName, file.relativePath AS file, rel.line AS line, model.name AS model, model.library AS library, table.name AS table, rel.operation AS operation, rel.expression AS expression ORDER BY file.relativePath, rel.line LIMIT 51

MATCH (source:Function)-[rel:ACCESSES_DATA_FUNCTION]->(model:DataModel) WHERE true OPTIONAL MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(source) OPTIONAL MATCH (model)-[:MAPS_TO_TABLE]->(table:Table) RETURN 'Function' AS sourceKind, source.name AS sourceName, file.relativePath AS file, rel.line AS line, model.name AS model, model.library AS library, table.name AS table, rel.operation AS operation, rel.expression AS expression ORDER BY file.relativePath, rel.line LIMIT 51

MATCH (source:Route)-[rel:ACCESSES_DATA_ROUTE]->(model:DataModel) WHERE true OPTIONAL MATCH (file:File)-[:DECLARES_ROUTE]->(source) OPTIONAL MATCH (model)-[:MAPS_TO_TABLE]->(table:Table) RETURN 'Route' AS sourceKind, source.path AS sourceName, file.relativePath AS file, rel.line AS line, model.name AS model, model.library AS library, table.name AS table, rel.operation AS operation, rel.expression AS expression ORDER BY file.relativePath, rel.line LIMIT 51

MATCH (source:EntryPoint)-[rel:ACCESSES_DATA_ENTRYPOINT]->(model:DataModel) WHERE true OPTIONAL MATCH (file:File)-[:DECLARES_ENTRYPOINT]->(source) OPTIONAL MATCH (model)-[:MAPS_TO_TABLE]->(table:Table) RETURN 'EntryPoint' AS sourceKind, source.trigger AS sourceName, file.relativePath AS file, rel.line AS line, model.name AS model, model.library AS library, table.name AS table, rel.operation AS operation, rel.expression AS expression ORDER BY file.relativePath, rel.line LIMIT 51

MATCH (file:File)-[:DECLARES_COMPONENT]->(component:Component) RETURN id(component) AS id, component.name AS name, component.kind AS kind, component.framework AS framework, file.relativePath AS file, component.line AS line, component.endLine AS endLine, component.isExported AS isExported, component.tagName AS tagName, component.selector AS selector, component.props AS props, component.hooks AS hooks, component.pendingRenders AS pendingRenders
MATCH (parent:Component)-[rel:RENDERS]->(child:Component) RETURN id(parent) AS parent, id(child) AS child, rel.line AS line, rel.props AS props, rel.client AS client, rel.template AS template
MATCH (component:Component)-[:COMPONENT_DEFINED_BY_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function) RETURN id(component) AS component, id(fn) AS fn
MATCH (component:Component)-[:COMPONENT_DEFINED_BY]->(class:Class)-[:DEFINES_METHOD]->(fn:Function) RETURN id(component) AS component, id(fn) AS fn, class.name AS className
MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(fn:Function) RETURN id(fn) AS id, fn.name AS name, fn.className AS className, file.relativePath AS file, fn.line AS line, fn.endLine AS endLine

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_CLASS]->(class:Class)-[:DEFINES_METHOD]->(fn:Function) RETURN id(fn) AS id, fn.name AS name, class.name AS className, file.relativePath AS file, fn.line AS line, fn.endLine AS endLine
MATCH (user:Function)-[rel:USES_HOOK]->(hook:Function) RETURN id(user) AS user, id(hook) AS hook, rel.line AS line
MATCH (user:Function)-[rel:USES_CONTEXT]->(context:Component) RETURN id(user) AS user, id(context) AS context, rel.line AS line

MATCH (file:File)-[:DECLARES_COMPONENT]->(component:Component) RETURN id(component) AS id, component.name AS name, component.kind AS kind, component.framework AS framework, file.relativePath AS file, component.line AS line, component.endLine AS endLine, component.isExported AS isExported, component.tagName AS tagName, component.selector AS selector, component.props AS props, component.hooks AS hooks, component.pendingRenders AS pendingRenders
MATCH (parent:Component)-[rel:RENDERS]->(child:Component) RETURN id(parent) AS parent, id(child) AS child, rel.line AS line, rel.props AS props, rel.client AS client, rel.template AS template

MATCH (file:File)-[:DECLARES_ENTRYPOINT]->(entrypoint:EntryPoint) WHERE true OPTIONAL MATCH (entrypoint)-[:ENTRYPOINT_HANDLED_BY]->(handler:Function) RETURN file.relativePath AS file, entrypoint.line AS line, entrypoint.kind AS kind, entrypoint.trigger AS trigger, entrypoint.library AS library, entrypoint.handlerName AS handlerName, handler.name AS handler ORDER BY file.relativePath, entrypoint.line, entrypoint.kind, entrypoint.trigger, handler.name LIMIT 51

MATCH (call:Call)-[:CALL_RESOLVES_TO]->(target:Function) MATCH (caller:Function)-[:CALLS]->(call) MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(caller) WHERE target.name = "track" RETURN target.name AS target, caller.name AS caller, 'Function' AS callerKind, file.relativePath AS file, call.line AS line, call.expression AS expression, 'CALLS' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, call.line LIMIT 21

MATCH (call:Call)-[:CALL_RESOLVES_TO]->(target:Function) MATCH (caller:Function)-[:CALLS]->(call) MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_CLASS]->(class:Class)-[:DEFINES_METHOD]->(caller) WHERE target.name = "track" RETURN target.name AS target, caller.name AS caller, 'Method' AS callerKind, class.name AS className, file.relativePath AS file, call.line AS line, call.expression AS expression, 'CALLS' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, call.line LIMIT 21

MATCH (call:Call)-[:CALL_RESOLVES_TO]->(target:Function) MATCH (file:File)-[:MODULE_CALLS]->(call) WHERE target.name = "track" RETURN target.name AS target, file.relativePath AS caller, 'File' AS callerKind, file.relativePath AS file, call.line AS line, call.expression AS expression, 'MODULE_CALLS' AS relationship ORDER BY file.relativePath, call.line LIMIT 21
MATCH (call:Call) WHERE call.callee IN $names OPTIONAL MATCH (call)-[target:CALL_RESOLVES_TO]->() RETURN id(call) AS id, count(target) AS resolved

output.completeness: No call named track in the scanned files is left unresolved, so the resolved callers (on every page) are all of them; callbacks and other references are in find_references.

calls.cypher: MATCH (file:File) RETURN file.relativePath AS file

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_FUNCTION]->(n:Function) WHERE file.relativePath IN $files RETURN id(n) AS id, n.name AS name, n.className AS className, file.relativePath AS file, file.path AS path, n.line AS line, n.endLine AS endLine

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_CLASS]->(class:Class)-[:DEFINES_METHOD]->(n:Function) WHERE file.relativePath IN $files RETURN id(n) AS id, n.name AS name, class.name AS className, file.relativePath AS file, file.path AS path, n.line AS line, n.endLine AS endLine
MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_CLASS]->(n:Class) WHERE file.relativePath IN $files RETURN id(n) AS id, n.name AS name, file.relativePath AS file, file.path AS path, n.line AS line, n.endLine AS endLine

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_INTERFACE]->(n:Interface) WHERE file.relativePath IN $files RETURN id(n) AS id, n.name AS name, file.relativePath AS file, file.path AS path, n.line AS line, n.endLine AS endLine

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_TYPE_ALIAS]->(n:TypeAlias) WHERE file.relativePath IN $files RETURN id(n) AS id, n.name AS name, file.relativePath AS file, file.path AS path, n.line AS line, n.endLine AS endLine
MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_ENUM]->(n:Enum) WHERE file.relativePath IN $files RETURN id(n) AS id, n.name AS name, file.relativePath AS file, file.path AS path, n.line AS line, n.endLine AS endLine
MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_VARIABLE]->(n:Variable) WHERE file.relativePath IN $files RETURN id(n) AS id, n.name AS name, file.relativePath AS file, file.path AS path, n.line AS line

MATCH (file:File)-[:DECLARES_ROUTE]->(n:Route) WHERE file.relativePath IN $files RETURN id(n) AS id, n.method AS method, coalesce(n.fullPath, n.path) AS routePath, file.relativePath AS file, file.path AS path, n.line AS line

MATCH (file:File)-[:DEFINES_CLASS]->(class:Class)-[:DEFINES_FIELD]->(field:Field) WHERE file.relativePath = $file RETURN class.name AS className, field.name AS name, field.typeName AS typeName, field.line AS line
MATCH (file:File)-[:IMPORTS]->(imp:Import) WHERE file.relativePath = $file RETURN imp.source AS source, imp.line AS line, imp.isTypeOnly AS isTypeOnly

MATCH (file:File)-[:DECLARES_ENTRYPOINT]->(entrypoint:EntryPoint) WHERE file.relativePath = $file RETURN entrypoint.kind AS kind, entrypoint.trigger AS trigger, entrypoint.handlerName AS handlerName, entrypoint.line AS line
